```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(leaflet)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(crosstalk)

# Official MLB ballpark elevations, coordinates, and Statcast-tracked regular-season
# home run totals (2015-2026 cumulative Statcast Era & 2026 single season)
mlb_stadiums <- tribble(
  ~stadium, ~team, ~division, ~city, ~lat, ~lon, ~elevation_ft, ~hr_statcast_total, ~games_statcast, ~hr_2026, ~avg_hr_dist_ft, ~roof_type, ~opened,
  "Coors Field", "Colorado Rockies", "NL West", "Denver, CO", 39.7559, -104.9942, 5180, 2436, 919, 211, 419, "Open-Air", 1995,

  "Kauffman Stadium", "Kansas City Royals", "AL Central", "Kansas City, MO", 39.0517, -94.4803, 910, 1838, 920, 196, 410, "Open-Air", 1973,
  "Target Field", "Minnesota Twins", "AL Central", "Minneapolis, MN", 44.9817, -93.2778, 840, 2234, 921, 161, 402, "Open-Air", 2010,
  "PNC Park", "Pittsburgh Pirates", "NL Central", "Pittsburgh, PA", 40.4469, -80.0057, 743, 1737, 920, 170, 401, "Open-Air", 2001,
  "Progressive Field", "Cleveland Guardians", "AL Central", "Cleveland, OH", 41.4962, -81.6852, 653, 2025, 919, 161, 396, "Open-Air", 1994,
  "Comerica Park", "Detroit Tigers", "AL Central", "Detroit, MI", 42.3390, -83.0485, 600, 2002, 918, 170, 393, "Open-Air", 2000,
  "Globe Life Field", "Texas Rangers", "AL West", "Arlington, TX", 32.7473, -97.0842, 600, 1229, 516, 181, 401, "Retractable", 2020,
  "Wrigley Field", "Chicago Cubs", "NL Central", "Chicago, IL", 41.9484, -87.6553, 596, 2184, 924, 238, 399, "Open-Air", 1914,
  "Rate Field", "Chicago White Sox", "AL Central", "Chicago, IL", 41.8299, -87.6338, 594, 2193, 924, 194, 395, "Open-Air", 1991,
  "American Family Field", "Milwaukee Brewers", "NL Central", "Milwaukee, WI", 43.0280, -87.9712, 593, 2253, 922, 169, 401, "Retractable", 2001,
  "Great American Ball Park", "Cincinnati Reds", "NL Central", "Cincinnati, OH", 39.0979, -84.5082, 482, 2539, 920, 207, 393, "Open-Air", 2003,
  "Busch Stadium", "St. Louis Cardinals", "NL Central", "St. Louis, MO", 38.6226, -90.1928, 450, 1803, 917, 132, 402, "Open-Air", 2006,
  "Dodger Stadium", "Los Angeles Dodgers", "NL West", "Los Angeles, CA", 34.0739, -118.2400, 267, 2429, 921, 190, 398, "Open-Air", 1962,
  "Rogers Centre", "Toronto Blue Jays", "AL East", "Toronto, ON", 43.6414, -79.3894, 250, 2156, 846, 163, 396, "Retractable", 1989,
  "Angel Stadium", "Los Angeles Angels", "AL West", "Anaheim, CA", 33.8003, -117.8827, 160, 2302, 921, 131, 403, "Open-Air", 1966,
  "Yankee Stadium", "New York Yankees", "AL East", "Bronx, NY", 40.8296, -73.9262, 55, 2619, 921, 216, 391, "Open-Air", 2009,
  "Daikin Park", "Houston Astros", "AL West", "Houston, TX", 29.7573, -95.3555, 50, 2299, 916, 215, 386, "Retractable", 2000,
  "Tropicana Field", "Tampa Bay Rays", "AL East", "St. Petersburg, FL", 27.7682, -82.6534, 42, 1868, 843, 197, 399, "Fixed Dome", 1990,
  "Citizens Bank Park", "Philadelphia Phillies", "NL East", "Philadelphia, PA", 39.9061, -75.1665, 40, 2368, 922, 201, 394, "Open-Air", 2004,
  "T-Mobile Park", "Seattle Mariners", "AL West", "Seattle, WA", 47.5914, -122.3325, 30, 2230, 915, 194, 394, "Retractable", 1999,
  "Nationals Park", "Washington Nationals", "NL East", "Washington, DC", 38.8730, -77.0074, 25, 2259, 928, 237, 402, "Open-Air", 2008,
  "Sutter Health Park", "Athletics", "AL West", "West Sacramento, CA", 38.5804, -121.5138, 25, 468, 156, 238, 401, "Open-Air", 2000,
  "Oriole Park at Camden Yards", "Baltimore Orioles", "AL East", "Baltimore, MD", 39.2838, -76.6217, 20, 2522, 921, 188, 399, "Open-Air", 1992,
  "Fenway Park", "Boston Red Sox", "AL East", "Boston, MA", 42.3467, -71.0972, 20, 2064, 923, 147, 397, "Open-Air", 1912,
  "Oracle Park", "San Francisco Giants", "NL West", "San Francisco, CA", 37.7786, -122.3893, 13, 1614, 924, 147, 396, "Open-Air", 2000,

  "loanDepot park", "Miami Marlins", "NL East", "Miami, FL", 25.7781, -80.2196, 7, 1721, 913, 147, 401, "Retractable", 2012
) |>
  mutate(
    hr_per_game = round(hr_statcast_total / games_statcast, 2),
    elevation_tier = factor(
      case_when(
        elevation_ft >= 5000 ~ "Mile High (5,180 ft)",
        elevation_ft >= 700 ~ "Highland (700–1,100 ft)",
        elevation_ft >= 100 ~ "Mid-Elevation (100–699 ft)",
        TRUE ~ "Near Sea Level (<100 ft)"
      ),
      levels = c(
        "Near Sea Level (<100 ft)",
        "Mid-Elevation (100–699 ft)",
        "Highland (700–1,100 ft)",
        "Mile High (5,180 ft)"
      )
    )
  )

# Pre-order stadium names by Statcast total HRs for clean horizontal bar ordering
stadium_levels <- mlb_stadiums |>
  arrange(hr_statcast_total) |>
  pull(stadium)

mlb_stadiums <- mlb_stadiums |>
  mutate(stadium_ranked = factor(stadium, levels = stadium_levels))

shared_parks <- SharedData$new(mlb_stadiums, key = ~stadium, group = "mlb_parks")

tier_colors <- c(
  "Near Sea Level (<100 ft)" = "#2c7fb8",
  "Mid-Elevation (100–699 ft)" = "#41ab5d",
  "Highland (700–1,100 ft)" = "#fe9929",
  "Mile High (5,180 ft)" = "#d95f02"
)

tier_pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = unname(tier_colors),
  levels = names(tier_colors)
)
```

## Stadium Elevation & Home Runs Across All 30 MLB Ballparks

How many home runs are actually hit at each Major League Baseball stadium—and how do **ballpark elevation** and **outfield dimensions** interact to shape those totals? Using official MLB Statcast ball-tracking data across the **Statcast Era (2015–2026)** alongside single-season **2026 home run counts**, we can compare all 30 current MLB ballparks by altitude, total home runs hit, home runs per game, and average home run distance:

- **Most Total Home Runs (2015–2026):** **Yankee Stadium** (2,619 HRs; 55 ft elevation), **Great American Ball Park** (2,539 HRs; 482 ft), **Oriole Park at Camden Yards** (2,522 HRs; 20 ft), and **Coors Field** (2,436 HRs; **5,180 ft**) top all active MLB venues.
- **Why Elevation Still Rules Ball Flight:** Even though Colorado pushed Coors Field's outfield fences far back to contain scoring, thin mile-high air propelled Coors Field to **2,436 home runs (#4 in MLB)** and an MLB-best **419-foot average home run distance**—nearly 30 feet longer than short-porch parks like Yankee Stadium (391 ft) and Daikin Park (386 ft). Meanwhile, sea-level **Oracle Park** (13 ft) sits lowest among long-tenured parks with just **1,614 home runs** (1.75 HR/game).
- *Note on newer MLB venues:* **Truist Park** (opened 2017; 1,842 HRs in 759 games), **Globe Life Field** (opened 2020; 1,229 HRs in 516 games), and **Sutter Health Park** (MLB home of the Athletics in 2025–2026; 468 HRs in 156 games, or an MLB-high 3.00 HR/game) have fewer cumulative Statcast-era games, so both **total HRs** and **HRs per game** (plus **2026 single-season HRs**) are shown below.

Use the filters below to explore stadiums by **division**, **roof design**, or **ballpark name**—your selections dynamically filter the map, both charts, and the directory table.

```{r}
bscols(
  widths = c(4, 4, 4),
  filter_select(
    id = "division_filter",
    label = "Filter by MLB Division:",
    sharedData = shared_parks,
    group = ~division
  ),
  filter_checkbox(
    id = "roof_filter",
    label = "Roof Design:",
    sharedData = shared_parks,
    group = ~roof_type,
    inline = TRUE
  ),
  filter_select(
    id = "park_selector",
    label = "Select / Compare Stadium(s):",
    sharedData = shared_parks,
    group = ~stadium
  )
)
```

### Interactive MLB Ballpark Map: Elevation & Home Runs Hit

Circle color indicates **elevation tier**, while circle size scales with **2026 home runs hit**. Hover or click any stadium marker to inspect its exact elevation and home run totals.

```{r}
leaflet(shared_parks, height = 470) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lon,
    lat = ~lat,
    radius = ~pmax(6, hr_2026 / 18),
    color = "#ffffff",
    fillColor = ~tier_pal(elevation_tier),
    fillOpacity = 0.88,
    stroke = TRUE,
    weight = 1.5,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>", stadium, "</b><br>",
      "Team: ", team, " (", division, ")<br>",
      "City: ", city, "<br>",
      "<b>Elevation: ", scales::comma(elevation_ft), " ft</b><br>",
      "<b>Total HRs (2015–2026): ", scales::comma(hr_statcast_total), "</b> (", games_statcast, " games)<br>",
      "<b>2026 Season HRs: ", hr_2026, "</b><br>",
      "HRs per Game: ", hr_per_game, "<br>",
      "Avg HR Distance: ", avg_hr_dist_ft, " ft<br>",
      "Roof: ", roof_type, " | Opened: ", opened
    ),
    label = ~paste0(
      stadium, " — ", scales::comma(elevation_ft), " ft | ",
      scales::comma(hr_statcast_total), " HRs (2015–26)"
    )
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = tier_pal,
    values = ~elevation_tier,
    title = "Stadium Elevation",
    opacity = 0.92
  )
```

### Stadium Elevation vs. Home Run Rate & Total Home Runs

Each point plots a ballpark's **elevation (feet)** against **home runs hit per game (2015–2026)**, with bubble size representing **average home run distance** and hover details showing exact cumulative and 2026 home run counts.

```{r}
plot_ly(
  data = shared_parks,
  x = ~elevation_ft,
  y = ~hr_per_game,
  color = ~elevation_tier,
  colors = tier_colors,
  size = ~avg_hr_dist_ft,
  sizes = c(11, 28),
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers",
  marker = list(opacity = 0.88, line = list(color = "#ffffff", width = 1.5)),
  text = ~paste0(
    "<b>", stadium, "</b> (", team, ")<br>",
    "Elevation: <b>", scales::comma(elevation_ft), " ft</b><br>",
    "Total HRs (2015–2026): <b>", scales::comma(hr_statcast_total), "</b><br>",
    "2026 Season HRs: <b>", hr_2026, "</b><br>",
    "HRs per Game: <b>", hr_per_game, "</b> (", games_statcast, " games)<br>",
    "Avg HR Distance: ", avg_hr_dist_ft, " ft<br>",
    "Roof: ", roof_type
  ),
  hoverinfo = "text"
) |>
  layout(
    title = "MLB Ballpark Elevation vs. Home Runs Hit per Game (2015–2026)",
    xaxis = list(title = "Stadium Elevation Above Sea Level (feet)", separatethousands = TRUE),
    yaxis = list(title = "Home Runs Hit per Game (Both Teams Combined)"),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = -0.2),
    height = 450,
    margin = list(l = 65, r = 25, t = 50, b = 85)
  ) |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
```

### Total Home Runs Hit at Each Current MLB Stadium (2015–2026)

```{r}
plot_ly(
  data = shared_parks,
  x = ~hr_statcast_total,
  y = ~stadium_ranked,
  color = ~elevation_tier,
  colors = tier_colors,
  type = "bar",
  orientation = "h",
  text = ~paste0(
    "<b>", stadium, "</b> (", city, ")<br>",
    "Elevation: <b>", scales::comma(elevation_ft), " ft</b><br>",
    "Total HRs (2015–2026): <b>", scales::comma(hr_statcast_total), "</b><br>",
    "2026 Season HRs: <b>", hr_2026, "</b><br>",
    "HRs per Game: ", hr_per_game, " across ", games_statcast, " games<br>",
    "Avg HR Distance: ", avg_hr_dist_ft, " ft"
  ),
  hoverinfo = "text"
) |>
  layout(
    title = "Cumulative Regular-Season Home Runs by MLB Ballpark (Statcast Era, 2015–2026)",
    xaxis = list(title = "Total Home Runs Hit at Stadium (2015–2026)", separatethousands = TRUE),
    yaxis = list(title = ""),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = -0.12),
    height = 700,
    margin = list(l = 195, r = 25, t = 50, b = 75)
  ) |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
```
